jobs.occupation: Junior IT Support -  Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about technology and eager to kick-start your career in IT support? We are looking for a Junior IT Support Engineer to join a dynamic international environment in the heart of Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As part of the IT team, you will be the first point of contact for end users and help ensure a smooth and efficient IT experience across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first-line IT support to employees.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, and Microsoft 365 issues.
• Managing incidents and service requests through the ticketing system.
• Preparing and configuring laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
• Assisting with onboarding and offboarding activities.
• Escalating complex issues when necessary and following up to resolution.
• Delivering excellent customer service to users at all levels of the business.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

jobs.occupation: Management Assistant at an International Law Firm in Brussels
jobs.description:
Join a leading international law firm in the heart of Brussels and become part of a dynamic, multicultural team supporting high-profile clients across Europe and beyond. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Management Assistant who thrives in a fast-paced professional services environment. You will work closely with Partners and senior stakeholders, playing a key role in the smooth day-to-day operations of a busy legal practice. The firm is known for its collaborative culture, international reach, and commitment to professional development. Offering excellent career prospects and exposure to complex legal matters, this role is ideal for someone looking to grow within a prestigious legal environment.

Jobomschrijving

Your responsibilities as a Management Assistant in a law firm: 

• Provide proactive administrative and legal support to Partners and legal teams.
• Manage complex calendars, meetings, travel arrangements, and business priorities.
• Prepare, format, proofread, and coordinate legal documents and correspondence.
• Act as a key liaison for clients, internal stakeholders, and external contacts.
• Ensure smooth office operations while handling multiple priorities with discretion.

Your strengths as a Management Assistant in a Law Firm: 

• Proven experience as a Management Assistant, Executive Assistant, or Legal Assistant within a law firm.
• Fluent in Dutch, English, and French, both written and spoken.
• Highly proactive, organized, and able to anticipate needs in a demanding environment.
• Trustworthy, discreet, and comfortable handling confidential information.
• Flexible all-round professional who thrives under pressure and manages busy schedules with ease.

A leading international mobility group is looking for a Social Relations Manager to play a strategic role in shaping and professionalising employee relations across Belgium.

With more than 3,000 employees, a nationwide presence and strong growth ambitions, the company operates in the public and private passenger transportation sector, collaborating with major mobility partners throughout Belgium. Backed by an international group active across multiple continents, the organisation combines local entrepreneurship with the strength of a global market leader.

As part of their continued expansion, they are seeking an experienced social relations expert to strengthen social dialogue, ensure compliance with Belgian labour legislation and support long-term organisational growth.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the HR Director, you will be responsible for managing and coordinating social relations at a national level. Acting as a key partner to HR, Operations and employee representative bodies, you will ensure a consistent and compliant approach to employee relations across multiple sites in Belgium.

Your main Responsibilities include:

• Coordinating Central and Local Works Councils
• Supporting management teams and HR stakeholders in social dialogue matters
• Leading and coordinating Belgian Social Elections
• Managing collective bargaining agreements and work regulations
• Ensuring compliance with Belgian labour legislation
• Coordinating social inspections and audit preparation
• Developing and professionalising social consultation processes and governance
• Acting as the internal expert for complex employee relations topics
• Supporting constructive relationships with trade unions and social partners

Location: Diegem, with regular travel across Belgian sites.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law or Human Ressources
• Minimum 7 years of experience in HR, Employee Relations or HR Business Partner positions within operational environments
• Strong expertise in Belgian social legislation
• Proven experience with:
• Works Councils
• Social Elections
• Trade Union Relations
• Social Inspections
• Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA)
• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
• Diplomatic, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach
• Strong organisational and project management skills
• Fluent in Dutch and French
• English is considered an asset

The company operates in the pharmaceutical sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Planning and Procurement Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Manage purchase orders and maintain accurate planning, purchasing, and ERP data.
• Coordinate with suppliers on orders, deliveries, documentation, and issue resolution.
• Monitor inventory levels and support inbound logistics and delivery tracking.
• Prepare reports, maintain records, and support KPI monitoring and data accuracy.
• Collaborate with planning, warehouse, logistics, customer service, and finance teams to support daily supply chain operations and follow up on action items.

A successful Planning and Procurement Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• 1-2 years of experience in an administrative, logistics, purchasing, or supply chain support role.
• Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP, JD Edwards, or similar) and good command of Microsoft Excel.
• Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and administrative organization.
• Effective communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Ability to prioritize tasks, work in a fast-paced environment, and collaborate across teams.
• Proactive, reliable, and team-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken).

jobs.occupation: Allround Office Manager - Brussels - Fast growing company
jobs.description:
Join a dynamic international company operating in the creative and design sector, where innovation, collaboration, and excellence are at the heart of everything they do. Based in Brussels, this exciting opportunity offers the chance to become the driving force behind a vibrant and fast-paced office environment. As Office Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations while supporting a talented and multicultural team. The company offers strong growth opportunities, exposure to inspiring projects, and the chance to work closely with senior stakeholders. This is the ideal role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a creative environment and making a real impact.

Jobomschrijving

Your responsibilities as an Office Manager in a creative and design-driven environment:

• Oversee the day-to-day office operations and ensure a seamless workplace experience.
• Coordinate facilities, suppliers, events, and office resources.
• Support leadership and teams with administrative and operational matters.
• Manage priorities, solve challenges, and bring structure to a dynamic environment.
• Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative office culture.

Your strenghts as an Office Manager in a creative and design-driven environment:

• Proven experience as an Office Manager or in a similar all-round position.
• Fluent in Dutch, English, and French.
• Highly organized and able to create structure in a fast-moving environment.
• Creative, hands-on, and proactive in finding solutions.
• Strong communicator with a trustworthy and positive mindset.

Your main responsibilities are arranging transport, preparing customs clearance information, and communicating with forwarders and transport partners. You will also manage item data and handle the processing and registration of purchases.
 
 

• Checking and recording invoices in the inventory system related to export. 

• Checking all kinds of documents (transport documents, certificates of origin, certificates of conformity, EUR1, ...) 

• Preparing and providing information required for customs clearance 

• Following up on open orders and taking action to ensure timely shipment. 

• Communicating with forwarders, transport companies, and customs-related stakeholders, including for transport arrangements. 

• Monitor delivery times and prices, take action where necessary 

• Coordinating with various departments, including Customer Service, to ensure the smooth flow of export operations. 

• Back up to the general administrative tasks to support the department  

 

 

• A customer-oriented mindset and strong problem-solving skills, combined with a collaborative approach, are essential. 

• The ability to work accurately and with attention to detail is important. 

• Knowledge and/or experience in export procedures and international transport is required. 

• An understanding of customs and excise regulations is considered an advantage. 

• Familiarity with Incoterms, together with technical understanding and an affinity for the product range, is a required. 

• Fluency in both French and English, spoken and written, is essential. 

• Good knowledge and hands-on experience with MS Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook, is necessary.

Are you an experienced Executive Assistant looking for a challenging role within a prestigious international environment? Do you thrive in a demanding, fast-paced setting where autonomy, proactivity and attention to detail are essential?

For one of our clients, a leading international law firm in Brussels, we are looking for a Senior Executive Assistant to support Partners and Associates within a high-performing team.

Your responsibilities as Executive Assistant

As an Executive Assistant, you will be responsible for:

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings.
• Organising international travel and handling travel arrangements.
• Preparing meetings and taking minutes when required.
• Providing high-level administrative support to Partners and Associates.
• Managing billing and invoicing, which represents a significant part of the role.
• Reviewing billing narratives and coordinating with Associates to ensure they meet client requirements.
• Handling credit notes, write-offs and other billing-related matters.
• Anticipating the needs of the Partners and proactively supporting them in their daily activities.
• Collaborating closely with the wider Assistant team and providing back-up when needed.

Your profile as Executive Assistant

We are looking for a senior, autonomous and proactive Executive Assistant who enjoys taking ownership and working in a demanding environment.

You ideally have:

• Several years of experience as an Executive Assistant, preferably within a law firm, consultancy or similarly demanding environment.
• Strong experience with billing/invoicing and excellent attention to detail.
• Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
• A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented mindset.
• The confidence to work with senior stakeholders and demanding personalities.
• A stable career history and a mature professional attitude.
• Excellent English skills with French and/or Dutch.
Above all, you are someone who anticipates, takes initiative and does not need to be micromanaged. You are confident, discreet and comfortable working with demanding personalities. Your personality and ability to build trust with the Partners will be just as important as your experience.

Our client is a well-established and specialized company operating in the field of machinery and railway equipment. They are known for their dynamic SME environment and strong team collaboration.

Jobomschrijving

The Internal Sales Representative plays a key role in supporting the sales team by managing quotations, processing orders, and ensuring smooth communication between customers, suppliers, and internal departments.

Key Responsibilities

• Receive and handle price requests via email, phone, and other channels
• Request quotations from suppliers and negotiate pricing and conditions with the Sales Director
• Prepare and send customer quotations
• Enter offers and orders into the ERP system (knowledge of Navision or Business Central is a strong asset)
• Follow up on ongoing quotations in collaboration with the sales team
• Monitor and manage ongoing orders (delivery timelines, framework agreements)
• Handle customer complaints and provide appropriate solutions
• Send payment reminders when required
• Collaborate closely with the administrative team
• Support the preparation of trade shows and exhibitions
• Assist in preparing orders and coordinating shipments
• Ensure electronic registration of warehouse entries and exits
• Participate in inventory counts when needed
• Provide occasional support in the warehouse (receiving and shipping goods)

Profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
• Previous experience in a back-office or order processing role
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office
• Trilingual: Dutch / French and English or German
• Detail-oriented, stress-resistant, and versatile
• Reliable, consistent, and commercially minded

Nice to have:

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or VCA standards

As Sales Account Manager Export, you will be responsible for expanding and strengthening our business across international markets outside Western Europe. 
 

You will focus primarily on developing relationships with large customers and distributors, ensuring sustainable growth and long-term partnerships.
 

You combine a strategic outlook with a hands-on approach to drive sales performance and unlock new opportunities.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 

•    Develop and manage relationships with key accounts and international distributors

•    Drive sales growth across export markets outside Western Europe

•    Identify and develop new business opportunities in assigned regions

•    Negotiate commercial agreements and contracts 

•    Set-up, manage, motivate, and support a network of agents

•    Monitor sales performance and ensure targets are achieved

•    Analyze market trends and customer needs to define growth strategies

•    Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, customer service, and supply chain

•    Represent the company at international trade fairs and customer meetings

•    You will translate internal commercial strategies into action and continuously improve the end-to-end sales process via our CRM platform (Dynamics 365). 

•    Proven experience in an international sales or export role

•    Strong experience managing key accounts and/or distributors

•    Commercially driven with excellent negotiation skills

•    Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented

•    Strong communication and relationship-building skills

•    Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)

•    Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis

The company is an international player in the chemical industry, focused on producing basic raw materials derived from oil and gas. These materials are used by other companies to manufacture products such as packaging, plastic components, industrial applications, and consumer goods.

Operating on a global scale, the organization combines manufacturing, logistics, and international trade within a highly integrated business model. The work environment is strongly process-driven, with a focus on quality, supply chain excellence, and customer satisfaction.

In addition, the company places a strong emphasis on innovation and sustainability, investing in more efficient production processes and the development of increasingly recyclable materials.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description

In this role, you will play a central part in processing and managing customer orders within an international environment. You will ensure smooth administrative handling while monitoring quality, timelines, and communication throughout the entire order lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate and manage the complete order process from request to delivery	
• Process sales orders and quotations with a strong focus on accuracy	
• Liaise with internal departments regarding product availability, deliveries, and invoicing	
• Prepare and manage export documentation for international shipments	
• Handle returns and follow up on customer complaints	
• Keep customers informed about order status and deliveries through reporting tools	
• Maintain proactive communication with stakeholders, including customers, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams	
• Prepare and distribute reports on order status, deliveries, and critical issues	
• Identify potential bottlenecks within processes and contribute to improvement initiatives	
• Participate in internal meetings and collaborate with various departments

Requirements
	
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience	
• 1 to 3 years of experience in customer service, administration, or order management	
• Experience in an international environment is a strong asset	
• Experience in the shipping industry	
• Experience with shipping documents (Sea Waybill, Bill of Lading,...)	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Teams, Power BI)	
• Knowledge of Incoterms and international payment terms is considered an advantage	
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously	
• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and accuracy	
• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset	
• Customer-focused with excellent communication skills	
• Team player who thrives in an open and collaborative working environment	
• Able to work independently with a hands-on approach	
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Italian, Spanish, or any other additional language is a plus.

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward‑thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 

• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 

• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 

• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.

• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Good knowledge of SAP, MRP planning and inventory management processes.

• Strong Excel and data analysis skills.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with a proactive and results-oriented mindset.
